title.original: CRAFT: Grounded Multi-Agent Coordination Under Partial Information
title.zh: CRAFT：部分信息条件下的有依据多智能体协调
title.en: CRAFT: Grounded Multi-Agent Coordination Under Partial Information

inclusion_reason.zh: CRAFT 交付部分信息环境、协作任务和分层错误诊断，可重复测量空间落地、信念和语用通信。
inclusion_reason.en: CRAFT supplies a partial-information environment, coordination tasks, and layered error diagnosis for repeatable measurement of grounding, belief, and pragmatic communication.

abstract.zh: CRAFT 在严格部分可观测条件下要求多个 Agent 通过自然语言共同搭建无人能独自看全的 3D 结构，用以诊断务实沟通能力。
abstract.en: CRAFT requires agents with strictly partial views to communicate in natural language and jointly build a 3D structure no agent can fully observe, diagnosing pragmatic coordination.

problem.zh: 既有多 Agent 基准很难分离空间落地、他心建模和沟通错误，也无法检验单体推理强是否真的转化为团队协作。
problem.en: Existing multi-agent benchmarks rarely separate spatial grounding, belief modeling, and communication errors or test whether stronger individual reasoning yields teamwork.

approach.zh: 作者将任务形式化为多发送者有界务实说话者问题，并用互补视角、共享建造目标和行为失败谱系评估协作。
approach.en: The task is formalized as a multi-sender bounded pragmatic-speaker problem with complementary views, a shared construction goal, and a taxonomy of behavioral failures.

system_design.zh: 环境为每个 Agent 提供不同局部观测和通信通道，执行器合并建造动作，诊断器按空间、信念与语用层级标注失败。
system_design.en: The environment gives each agent a different local observation and communication channel, merges construction actions, and labels failures across spatial, belief, and pragmatic layers.

key_results.zh: 更强推理能力并不稳定带来更好协作，小型开放模型有时可匹敌前沿系统，个体表达质量也不足以保证共同成功。
key_results.en: Stronger reasoning does not reliably yield better coordination; smaller open models sometimes match frontier systems, and good individual communication does not ensure joint success.

limitations.zh: 单一 3D 建造范式可能偏重空间语言，未覆盖竞争激励、工具故障、长期角色变化或现实组织中的不对称权限。
limitations.en: A single 3D construction paradigm emphasizes spatial language and does not cover competing incentives, tool failures, evolving roles, or asymmetric permissions in real organizations.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
